title: Shared default administrator password in factory firmware
finding: All units ship with the same administrator password, printed in the manual; first-boot does not force a change.
risk_and_implication: Any network-adjacent attacker can take over the device and its connected sensors.
reproduction: Factory-reset test unit; log in to https://<device>/admin with the documented default credentials (E-012).
recommendation: Generate a unique per-device credential at manufacturing or force credential change on first boot; disable the admin interface until set.
implementation_guidance: Provision a per-unit random password printed on the device label or require setup via the app with proof of physical possession; enforce in firmware/admin/auth.c before any session is issued.
documentation_change: Update Annex II point 8(a) commissioning instructions and the risk assessment entry for (2)(b).
retest_criteria: Fresh unit refuses documented default credentials and requires a unique or user-set credential before exposing admin functions; evidence re-captured on the remediated firmware.

title: No Article 14 reporting capability
finding: No registration on the ENISA single reporting platform, no determination of the CSIRT designated as coordinator, no procedure defining awareness, deadlines, templates or user notification.
risk_and_implication: A live obligation since 11 September 2026 cannot be met; an actively exploited vulnerability would be reported late or not at all.
reproduction: Tabletop drill E-040: no participant could identify the platform, the CSIRT or the 24-hour step.
recommendation: Register a Primary Assigned Representative on the single reporting platform, determine the CSIRT (main establishment NL), adopt the reporting playbook and templates, assign on-call, run a drill.
implementation_guidance: Use templates/article-14-reporting-playbook.md and article-14-notification-forms.md; integrate with the incident response runbook.
documentation_change: Add the reporting procedure to the technical documentation (Annex VII point 2(b) process description).
retest_criteria: Platform registration evidenced; procedure approved; drill completed with early warning simulated within 24 hours and notification within 72 hours.
